description: This file defines the MealMaster class, a subclass of Integration, responsible for parsing recipe files, extracting recipe details, and splitting recipe files into individual recipes. It interacts with models like Recipe, Ingredient, Keyword, and Step, and uses an IngredientParser for ingredient processing.

classes.name: MealMaster
classes.description: A class for importing and processing recipes from MealMaster formatted files, extending the Integration base class.

methods.name: get_recipe_from_file
methods.description: Parses a recipe file to extract recipe details, ingredients, directions, and creates corresponding database entries.

methods.name: get_file_from_recipe
methods.description: Method intended to generate a file from a recipe; not implemented.

methods.name: split_recipe_file
methods.description: Splits a file containing multiple recipes into individual recipe strings based on specific delimiters.
